title: セイバールート四日目-05

pages.ja:
「…………………………………………」
本来なら悩むまでもない問題だ。
俺は素人で、遠坂は魔術師としてもマスターとしても一人前。
昨夜の事もあるし、ここは遠坂と手を組む方が賢明だろう。
だが

pages.en:
“…”

Ordinarily, this wouldn't even be a question.

I'm an amateur. Tohsaka is fully fledged as both a mage and a Master. After what happened last night, joining forces with her is obviously the sensible choice.

But—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……”
It should be something I don’t even need to think about.
I’m a novice, and Tohsaka is at her full potential as a Master and a magus.
Considering the events yesterday, it’d be smarter to join up with Tohsaka.
But

pages.ja:
「衛宮くん。返事、聞きたいんだけど」
「……………………」
ここで協力関係を結ぶのは早計な気がする。
遠坂が俺を騙すなんて事はないだろうが、まずは自分だけで状況を把握するべきだ。
そうしなければ、何が正しくて何が間違っているのか、判断がつかなくなる。

pages.en:
“Emiya. I'd like an answer.”

“…”

Something tells me it would be rash to form an alliance here and now.

I don't think Tohsaka would deceive me, but first I need to understand the situation for myself.

Otherwise, I'll lose any means of judging what's right and what's wrong.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Emiya-kun. I want to hear your response.”
“……”
I feel like I’m being too hasty joining up with someone right now.
I don’t think Tohsaka is out to trick me, but I should figure out the situation first.
Or else, I won’t be able to judge what’s right and what’s wrong.

pages.ja:
「
すまん、遠坂。
心配してくれるのはありがたいけど、いい返事はできない。事が事だからな。簡単に方針を決めちゃいけない気がする」

pages.en:
“—Sorry, Tohsaka.

“I appreciate you worrying about me, but I can't give you the answer you want. This is too important. I don't think I should settle on a course of action so easily.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
I’m sorry, Tohsaka.
I’m glad you’re worried about me, but I can’t give you the response you want. This is a serious matter, you know? I feel I shouldn’t rush to a decision.”

pages.ja:
まっすぐに見返して返答する。
遠坂は少しだけ目を細めて、そう、と感情のない声で頷いた。
pages.jaRuby:
まっすぐに見返して返答する。

pages.en:
I meet her gaze and give her my answer.

Tohsaka narrows her eyes just slightly, then nods and says, “I see,” in a voice devoid of emotion.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I look directly back at her and answer.
Tohsaka narrows her eyes a bit and nods emotionlessly.

pages.ja: 「それじゃ交渉は決裂ね。……ま、確かに衛宮くんの言い分も正しいわ。本当に勝つ気があるなら誰も信用できないもの」
pages.jaRuby: 「それじゃ交渉は決裂ね。……ま、確かに衛宮くんの言い分も正しいわ。本当に勝つ気があるなら誰も信用できないもの」
pages.en: “Then our negotiations have failed. …Well, I suppose you do have a point. If you genuinely mean to win, you can't trust anyone.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Then the negotiation has failed. …Well, you have a point too. If you really do want to win, you can’t trust anyone.”

pages.ja: 「そんな事ないぞ。俺、遠坂は信用してる。ただ一人で決められる事じゃないだけだ。俺がセイバーのマスターなら、あいつに無断で約束はできない」
pages.jaRuby: 「そんな事ないぞ。俺、遠坂は信用してる。ただ一人で決められる事じゃないだけだ。俺がセイバーのマスターなら、あいつに無断で約束はできない」
pages.en: “That's not it. I trust you, Tohsaka. This just isn't something I can decide by myself. If I'm Saber's Master, I can't make promises without consulting her.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “That’s not it. I trust you, Tohsaka. It’s just that I can’t decide on my own. If I’m Saber’s Master, I can’t make a promise without her consent.”

pages.ja: 「なるほど、確かにそうね。貴方はもう歴としたマスターなんだから」
pages.jaRuby: 「なるほど、確かにそうね。貴方はもう[ruby text=れっき]歴としたマスターなんだから」
pages.en: “I see. That's certainly true. You are a proper Master now, after all.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “I see. That is true. You are a Master now.”

pages.ja:
納得したように頷いて、遠坂はあっさりと背を向けた。
長い髪をなびかせて去っていく。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
She nods as though satisfied, then turns her back on me without another word.

Her long hair streaming behind her, she walks away.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Giving a nod of understanding, Tohsaka turns away.
She leaves, her hair fluttering behind her.

pages.ja:
そうして、味方になるかも知れなかった少女は一度だけ振り返って、
「それじゃあね。次に出会ったら敵同士だから」
あのイリヤという少女と同じように、冷たい警告を残していった。
pages.jaRuby:

「それじゃあね。次に出会ったら敵同士だから」
あのイリヤという少女と同じように、冷たい警告を残していった。
pages.en:
Then the girl who might have become my ally looks back just once.

“Goodbye, then. The next time we meet, we'll be enemies.”

She leaves me with a cold warning, just like the girl called Illya.
pages.mirrorMoon:
And the girl who could have been my ally turns, and…
“Goodbye. We will be enemies the next time we meet.”
…Like the girl Illya, leaves a cold warning.

昨夜の事件
夜の学校でランサーとアーチャーの戦いを目撃してからこっち、まともに考える時間がなかった為だ。

pages.en:
“—All right.”

I take a quiet breath and try to get a handle on the situation.

Ever since last night—ever since I witnessed Lancer and Archer fighting at the school—I haven't had a moment to think properly.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Alright.”
I take a quick breath and consider my current situation.
I haven’t had time to sit down and think since the incident last night
when I saw the battle between Lancer and Archer.

pages.ja:
夜の学校でランサーに胸を貫かれ、なんでか助かって家に戻り、再びランサーに襲われ
「セイバーに助けられて、マスターになった」
教会で聞いた事。
聖杯戦争という殺し合い。
勝者に与えられる、あらゆる望みを叶えるという聖杯。

pages.en:
Lancer pierced my heart at the school. Somehow I survived and made it home, only for Lancer to attack me again—

“Then Saber saved me, and I became a Master.”

And there was everything I heard at the church.

The slaughter known as the Holy Grail War.

The Holy Grail awarded to its victor, said to grant any wish.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I had my chest pierced by Lancer, returned home after I was somehow saved, I was attacked once again by Lancer, and
“I was saved by Saber and became a Master.”
What I heard at the church.
The murderous battle called the Holy Grail War.
The Holy Grail that grants any wish, supposedly given to the winner.

pages.ja:
分からない事だらけだが、俺には確かな案内役がいる。
「
そうだな。まずはセイバーに話を聞かないと」
pages.jaRuby:
分からない事だらけだが、俺には確かな案内役がいる。
「
そうだな。まずはセイバーに話を聞かないと」
pages.en:
Almost none of it makes sense to me, but I do have one reliable guide.

“—Right. The first thing I need to do is talk to Saber.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
There are many things I don’t know about, but I definitely have a guide.
“
Yeah, I need to go and talk to Saber first.”

pages.ja:
屋敷をまわる。
人がいそうなところ
客間をすべて見てまわったが、セイバーの姿はなかった。
pages.jaRuby:
屋敷をまわる。
人がいそうなところ
客間をすべて見てまわったが、セイバーの姿はなかった。
pages.en:
I search the house.

I check every guest room—everywhere a person might be—but there is no sign of Saber.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I look around the house.
I look around where someone could be, all the guest rooms, but I cannot find Saber.

pages.ja: 「おかしいな……あの格好なんだ、いればすぐに判りそうなもんだけど」
pages.jaRuby: 「おかしいな……あの格好なんだ、いればすぐに判りそうなもんだけど」
pages.en: “That's strange… Dressed like that, she shouldn't be hard to spot.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “That’s weird… she’s in that outfit, so you’d think it’d be easy to find her.”

pages.ja:
そうは言いつつも、屋敷のどこにもセイバーの鎧姿は見あたらなかった。
サーヴァントは霊体になれるらしいが、生憎俺にはそんな芸当はさせられない。
いや、そもそも

pages.en:
Yet despite what I say, Saber's armored figure is nowhere to be found in the house.

Apparently Servants can assume spiritual form, but unfortunately I'm incapable of making her do anything of the kind.

No, before that—
pages.mirrorMoon:
Even saying that, I can’t find Saber anywhere.
It seems Servants can become spirits, but I can’t do that.
No, first of all

pages.ja: 「マスターだなんて言うけど、俺、あいつの事をなんにも知らないんだよな」
pages.jaRuby: 「マスターだなんて言うけど、俺、あいつの事をなんにも知らないんだよな」
pages.en: “They call me her Master, but I don't know the first thing about her.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Even though they call me a Master, I don’t know anything about her.”

pages.ja:
セイバーが何者なのか、サーヴァントがどんな理屈で居るモノなのか、俺にはてんで判らない。
ただ判る事と言えば、それは。
どんなに優れた存在であろうと、戦えば傷を負い、斬られれば血を流すという事だった。

pages.en:
I have no idea who Saber is, or by what principles a being like a Servant exists.

There is only one thing I do understand.

No matter how extraordinary they may be, they are wounded when they fight, and bleed when they are cut.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I don’t understand who she is or how she exists.
The only thing I understand is…
No matter how superior their existence may be, they still get hurt in a fight and they bleed if they are wounded.

板張りの床に正座したセイバーは、鎧を纏ってはいなかった。
セイバーは彼女らしい上品な洋服に着替えていて、無言で床に座していた。

pages.en:
“—Ah.”

I find Saber in the silent dojo.

She looks different from the girl I saw yesterday.

Sitting formally on the wooden floor, Saber wears no armor.

She has changed into an elegant Western outfit that suits her perfectly, and sits there without a word.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Oh.”
Saber is in the silent dojo.
Her appearance is different from yesterday’s.
Sitting in a Japanese-style on the wooden floor, she is not wearing her armor.
She has changed into refined clothes that suit her well, and is sitting silently.

Saber is beautiful, seated with her back perfectly straight and her eyes closed.

The way she melts into the silence calls to mind pure, still water.

“
”

With her back straight and sitting Japanese-style with her eyes closed, Saber looks beautiful.
Her state, melting into the silence, reminds me of pure water.

なら

pages.en:
“————”

And with that, the last thorn of doubt falls away.

Servant or not, she seems to me something sacred.

If that is so—then whatever lies ahead, I cannot imagine myself taking the wrong path.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
”
And that removes the last doubts within me.
Even if she is a Servant, I think she is holy.
So
I should not follow a wrong path with her.

声をかける。

pages.en:
“Saber.”

I call to her.

Without the least surprise, Saber opens her eyes and slowly turns her gaze toward me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Saber.”
I call out.
Saber slowly opens her eyes and returns my gaze.

pages.ja:

落ち着いた声。
染みいるように響く彼女の声は、ひどくこの道場にあっていた。
pages.jaRuby:

染みいるように響く彼女の声は、ひどくこの道場にあっていた。
pages.en:
“You are awake, Shirou.”

Her voice is calm.

Its clear, penetrating sound belongs in this dojo more than I can say.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“You are awake, Shirou.”
A calm voice.
Her voice, echoing through the dojo as if permeating it, is surprisingly suited to this place.

“—Yeah. I only woke up a little while ago. What are you doing in here?”

“Resting my body. I cannot tend to you myself, Shirou, so I thought the least I could do was ensure I remained in perfect condition.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“

“I was resting. I cannot treat you, so I thought I would get myself into perfect condition.”

“—”

Saber speaks evenly, looking directly at me.

…There's something about it. A tension unlike the kind I feel around Tohsaka.

!”

I feel a tension, different from the one I felt with Tohsaka.

“Shirou? What is wrong? Is your body still—?”

“N-No, I'm fine too…! I'm just getting flustered all on my own, so don't worry about it…!”

I jerk back a step and shake my head furiously.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Shirou? What is it? Could it be that your body is still…?”
“…!
N-No, there’s no problem…! I’m just perplexed for my own reasons, so don’t worry…!”
I take a step back, shaking my head.

pages.ja:
「？」
不思議そうに首をかしげる彼女から目を逸らして、ともかくバクバクいってる心臓を落ち着かせた。
pages.jaRuby:
「？」

pages.en:
“?”

I avert my eyes from her puzzled tilt of the head and concentrate on calming my pounding heart.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…?”
Looking away from Saber, who is tilting her head questioningly, I calm down my pounding heart.

！」
ふう、と深呼吸を一度する。

pages.en:
“…Get a grip. What am I so nervous about—?”

I draw one deep breath.

…It doesn't feel as though this is going to subside anytime soon. If anything, it feels beyond settling altogether.

“…Damn it. Why did she have to change clothes…?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Calm down. What am I so tense about
!?”
I take a deep breath.
…But it doesn’t seem to die down quickly. In fact, I don’t think it ever will.
“…Geez, why has she changed…?”

セイバーの服装はあまりにも現実感がありすぎて、否応なしに異性を意識してしまうのだ。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
The complaint slips out under my breath.

Saber's clothes make her look altogether too real. I can't help becoming conscious of her as a girl.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I complain without meaning to.
Saber’s clothes are so real that they make me conscious of her womanhood, whether I like it or not.

pages.ja:
……とにかく、彼女はとんでもない美人だ。
それは昨日で知っていたつもりだったが、今さらに思い知らされた。
こうして、ああいう女の子らしい格好をされると、健全な男子としてとにかく困る。
pages.jaRuby:
……とにかく、彼女はとんでもない美人だ。

こうして、ああいう女の子らしい格好をされると、健全な男子としてとにかく困る。
pages.en:
…In any case, she's astonishingly beautiful.

I thought I had understood that yesterday, but now I'm being taught the lesson all over again.

When she dresses like an ordinary girl, it puts a healthy young man in a very difficult position.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…She is terribly beautiful.
I thought I figured that out yesterday, but she really hits me with it now.
If she dresses so much like a girl, as a healthy guy, I’m troubled.

かといって、黙り込む為に彼女を捜していた訳じゃない。彼女は苦手だが、だからといって黙っていたら一生このままだ。

“Shirou.”

The moment our eyes meet, I tense up.

But I didn't search for her just to stand here in silence. She may make me uncomfortable, but if I let that silence win, we'll be like this forever.
